checks.name: task-card, relay, and task-spine focused tests
static checks
checks.command: python3 -m compileall -q house/relay && ruff check changed files && ruff format --check changed files && git diff --check

claim_ceiling: A deterministic static view of supplied canonical task-card projections. It does not read a task-spine database or journal, create/mutate/dispatch tasks, contact workers/providers, bind/refresh a listener, start a viewer, launch a browser, call iTerm, accept terminal input, grant authority, or open a reverse channel.
